items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And after that I played with John, with Dizzy.

ctx.x: That's right. And I mean, this was just his way. It wasn't -- he wasn't capable of changing. Lester was very strong in his beliefs, and in his life style, you know. So they could destroy him. And something actually happened to him then, you know. So I played with him around New York a couple of times, after that, and he had many groups after that. But to me, I don't know, it was just never -- not quite the same. And incidently, during this -- right after I came out Kenny Clark introduced me to John Lewis. I think…
Well, John had that -- before the war John hadn't been in the -- in New York, had he?
